{{nihongo|'''Nikabe Shrine'''|仁壁神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Sannomiya, {{ill|Yamaguchi (city)|Q207876|qid=Q207876}}, {{ill|Yamaguchi Prefecture|Q127264|qid=Q127264}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, the {{ill|Ichinomiya|Q1656379|qid=Q1656379|lt=third-ranking shrine}} of {{ill|Suō Province|Q1053037|qid=Q1053037}}, and under the former {{ill|Q712534|lt=shrine ranking system}} it was a {{ill|Ken-sha|qid=Q90139226|lt=kensha}}. {{nihongo|'''Nikabe Shrine'''|仁壁神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Suo Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
The current enshrined deities are as follows<ref name="説明板">Precinct information board.</ref>.
; Main enshrined deities
:* Right hall: {{ill|Shitateruhime|Q11307233|qid=Q11307233|lt=Shitateruhime-no-Mikoto}} (したてるひめのみこと)
:* Center hall: {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Uwatsutsuo-no-Mikoto}} (うわつつのおのみこと), {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Nakatsutsuo-no-Mikoto}} (なかつつのおのみこと), {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Sokotsutsuo-no-Mikoto}} (そこつつのおのみこと)
:* Left hall: {{ill|Ajisukitakahikone|Q506610|qid=Q506610|lt=Ajisukitakahikone-no-Mikoto}} (あじすきたかひこねのみこと)
; Associated deities
:* Zuishu Hall: {{ill|Kamimusubi|lt=Kamimusubi|UNKNOWN|qid=Q3275901|lt=Kamimusubi-no-kami}} (かみむすびのかみ), plus seven others

In the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'' compiled in {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Encho}} 5 ({{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), only one seat is recorded. Regarding the original deity, one theory holds it was Shitateruhime-no-Mikoto{{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}, while ''Nikabe Jinja Chinza-ko'' treats Ajisukitakahikone-no-Mikoto as main deity, Shitateruhime-no-Mikoto as co-enshrined deity, and the Sumiyoshi triad as later combined deities.

== History ==
== Founding ==
Founding date is unknown. Shrine tradition says that when {{ill|Emperor Sujin|ar|الإمبراطور سوجين|arz|الامبراطور سوجين|azb|سوجین (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Sujin|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سوجین|cs|Sudžin|de|Sujin|el|Αυτοκράτορας Σουτζίν|es|Sujin Tennō|fa|امپراتور سوجین|fr|Sujin|hr|Sujin|id|Kaisar Sujin|it|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇|ka|სუძინი|ko|스진 천황|ms|Maharaja Sujin|nl|Sujin|pl|Sujin|pt|Sujin|ru|Император Судзин|sh|Car Sujin|simple|Emperor Sujin|sl|Cesar Sudžin|sr|Суџин|sv|Sujin|th|จักรพรรดิซูจิง|tl|Emperador Sujin|tr|Sujin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Судзін|uz|Imperator Sujin|vi|Thiên hoàng Sujin|yo|Emperor Sujin|zh|崇神天皇|zh_classical|崇神天皇|zh_min_nan|Suzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|崇神天皇|qid=Q333530}} set shrine estate households in year 7 of his reign, the shrine was also granted Miyano-shō as shrine households.

Originally it stood in {{ill|Miyano|Q11455324|qid=Q11455324|lt=Miyano-shimo Village}}, but after a strange phenomenon of jewel-like light flying all day at the current site, it was moved here in {{ill|1104|Q12490|qid=Q12490}} ({{ill|Chōji|Q1150870|qid=Q1150870}} 1).

== Overview ==
In the {{ill|Rikkokushi|Q1151168|qid=Q1151168|lt=official national histories}}, it is recorded that in {{ill|858|Q30371|qid=Q30371}} ({{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten'an}} 2), "Nikabe no Kami" was promoted from Senior Sixth Rank Upper to Junior Fifth Rank Lower, and in {{ill|867|Q30347|qid=Q30347}} ({{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jogan}} 9), "Nikabe no Kami" was promoted to Junior Fourth Rank Lower{{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}.

In the ''{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}'' {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Register of Shrines}} compiled in Encho 5 (927), it is listed in {{ill|Suō Province|Q1053037|qid=Q1053037}}, {{ill|Yoshiki District, Yamaguchi|Q8192583|qid=Q8192583}} as "Nikabe Jinja" and ranked as {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} (the only one in Yoshiki District){{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}.

After that, divine rank rose in {{ill|939|Q23422|qid=Q23422}} ({{ill|Tengyō|Q1327340|qid=Q1327340}} 2), {{ill|1081|Q19450|qid=Q19450}} ({{ill|Eihō|Q1193881|qid=Q1193881}} 1), {{ill|1180|Q19702|qid=Q19702}} ({{ill|Jishō|Q1194671|qid=Q1194671}} 4), and {{ill|1187|Q19731|qid=Q19731}} ({{ill|Bunji (era)|Q1194415|qid=Q1194415}} 3; equivalent to {{ill|Genryaku|Q1194250|qid=Q1194250}} 4), reaching Senior Third Rank{{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}.

In the "Suo Miyano-sho Tachi-kenmon" of {{ill|1195|Q19745|qid=Q19745}} ({{ill|Kenkyū|Q1193933|qid=Q1193933}} 6), it appears as "Ninko-gu-sha," and shrine lands are recorded as 6 cho 20 bu of lower-upper-class fields, 3 cho 9 dan 20 bu of middle-middle-class fields, and 2 cho of upper-lower-class fields{{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}.

In Suo Province it was long ranked third after {{ill|Tamanooya Shrine (Q11572731)|Q11572731|qid=Q11572731}} (ichinomiya) and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izumo Shrine}} (ninomiya). When {{ill|Ōuchi Yoshioki|Q909270|qid=Q909270}} returned from campaign in {{ill|Kyushu|Q13987|qid=Q13987}} in {{ill|1494|Q6693|qid=Q6693}} ({{ill|Meiō|Q1193841|qid=Q1193841}} 6) and reported victory to five shrines in Suo, this shrine received his worship third{{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}.

In {{ill|1569|Q6653|qid=Q6653}} ({{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}} 12), during {{ill|Ouchi Teruhiro Rebellion|Q11432567|qid=Q11432567}}, when {{ill|Ōuchi Teruhiro|Q11432566|qid=Q11432566}} raided Yamaguchi, the shrine burned, but it was rebuilt by {{ill|Mōri Terumoto|ca|Mōri Terumoto|cs|Terumoto Móri|de|Mōri Terumoto|eo|Mori Terumoto|es|Mōri Terumoto|fa|موری تروموتو|fi|Mōri Terumoto|fr|Mōri Terumoto|id|Mori Terumoto|it|Mōri Terumoto|ja|毛利輝元|kk|Мори Тэрумото|ko|모리 데루모토|nl|Mori Terumoto|pl|Terumoto Mōri|pt|Mōri Terumoto|ru|Мори Тэрумото|sk|Terumoto Móri|th|โมริ เทรูโมโตะ|tr|Mōri Terumoto|uk|Морі Терумото|vi|Mori Terumoto|zh|毛利輝元|qid=Q1142657}}{{Sfn|Nikabe Shrine (Heibonsha)|1980}}. == Cultural properties ==
== Yamaguchi City designated cultural properties ==
* Tangible cultural property
** Wooden lion head (sculpture) - early Edo period, made in 1608 (Keicho 13), total length 55.7 cm. Designated March 2, 1982 (Showa 57)<ref name="説明板"/>.

The honden had also been designated a Yamaguchi Prefecture tangible cultural property on November 11, 1977 (Showa 52), but was lost in the 1997 fire.
